title: Eva Live (GOAI) Opens Presale of AI-Powered Drones as Pentagon Seeks Record $75 Billion for Drone Warfare
summary: Eva Defense opens presale ordering for its developing hybrid VTOL Droneship Carrier, with proposed systems starting at $295,000 and initial deliveries targeted for 2027.
